# Van route timetable

Stop times for the two network vans, kept current by [[Jory Petrakis]]. Morning runs deliver what was sorted the day before; afternoon runs collect what branches packed that day.

## Weekday loop

| Van | Stop | Time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| One | Main Street | 8:30 and 2:45 |
| One | Pinecrest | 9:30 and 1:45 |
| One | Millbrook sorting room | 10:30 and 3:30 |
| Two | Eastgate | 8:45 and 1:30 |
| Two | Harlow Junction | 10:00 and 2:30 |
| Two | Millbrook sorting room | 11:15 and 3:45 |

## Holidays

No runs on network holidays. Bins wait at the branch until the next weekday.
